title: Resilient Console layout: modal stacking, chart resize & table reflow for edge viewports
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: finalize and prototype resilient layout rules for Console pages (dashboards, rollout detail, billing/cost views) that avoid visual regressions across a wide matrix of browsers and device widths. This ticket captures design decisions, visual specs, and the test matrix for: 1) modal stacking + scroll traps when combined with side panels, 2) charts that should switch between canvas/svg fallback at narrow widths and maintain readability, 3) table column overflow and prioritized column collapse, and 4) cost-breakdown panels that must remain actionable at 320–1280px.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec created with explicit CSS breakpoint rules and fallback behaviors for <320px, 320–480px, 481–768px, 769–1024px, >1024px
Figma prototype with working modal stack and modal+panel interaction flows (desktop and mobile) linked below
Table reflow pattern documented (priority columns, horizontal scroll gating, cell truncation rules) and dev checklist signed off by ENG
Chart fallback rules (SVG -> canvas -> simplified sparkline) documented with performance notes and accessibility descriptions
Cross-browser verification matrix completed (Chromium, Firefox ESR, Safari desktop + iOS, Edge) with screenshots and known limitations
Accessibility: keyboard navigation for modals and table row actions verified; color contrast documented for cost charts
Hand-off package includes annotated tokens, breakpoint CSS snippets, interaction notes, and 2 small interactive prototypes for dev handoff
comments: 2025-11-03 - Maya Chen: Initial discovery & pattern proposals uploaded to Figma. Collected feedback from PM (Alessio Ramos) about prioritizing cost charts for mobile-first views.
2025-11-04 - Owen Patel: Prototype branch created; started implementing modal z-index and inert scrolling experimental CSS. Noted Safari iOS oddity with fixed footers when keyboard opens.
2025-11-06 - Alessa Ramos (PM): Reviewed table-collapse approach. Recommended showing critical columns (name, status, actions) first and pushing metadata into an inspect flyout for narrow screens.

2025-11-07 - Design review: Decided to use progressive enhancement — full interactive charts at >=769px, simplified sparkline for 481–768px, and numeric-only trend for <480px. Documented performance trade-offs for canvas vs SVG.

2025-11-08 - QA note (from Ryan O'Neill): Will run cross-browser screenshot tests after dev PR. Flagged potential visual jitter on Firefox when animating chart tooltips; suggested disabling motion on low-power devices.

2025-11-10 - Owen Patel: Updated prototype to include keyboard focus states for modal close and table action menu. Ready for engineering kickoff and handoff next week. Attached PR and test-run screenshots in dev links.
